rationale: The title and abstract evaluate an administrative 'one-window' pilot integrating application forms and eligibility documentation across municipal social assistance programmes in Arzamas, Russia, measuring staff benefit-processing efficiency and client application time savings. Neither household/community water nor sanitation service access is mentioned or examined (fails C1 and C4; E01 wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both the narrow rule-type reading and the literal plain wording of Criterion 2 because the study concerns general municipal social assistance welfare administration rather than water or sanitation service access (E01).

evidence_quotes.quote: Savings from Integrating Administrative Systems for Social Assistance Programmes in Russia
Specifically, the pilot introduced a unified application form for all the major social assistance programs in the city
Staff efficiency improvements are substantial: under the one-window system, 127 benefits are processed per month per staff member
